career.jobDescription: We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Backend Developer with 3–5 years of experience to design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems that power high-performance applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Node.js, Python, or Java, and be capable of developing efficient server-side logic and robust database structures to support complex business needs.

children.text: Effective communication and teamwork across cross-functional teams.
Ownership-driven with attention to detail and quality.
Continuous learner with adaptability to evolving technologies.

career.education: B.Tech in Computer Science and equivalent
career.preferredQualifications:
Languages: Strong proficiency in Node.js, Python, or Java.

Frameworks: Experience with Spring Boot, Flask, Django, or FastAPI.

Cloud Platforms: Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS).

Databases: Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

API Development: Solid experience in building RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.

Containerization: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

DevOps Tools: Familiarity with Git, Jenkins, and CI/CD workflows.
